title: SONGPAL CUMBIA NIGHT (Cumbia × Tech-House × Dub) [118]
style: Colombian cumbia meets tech-house and dub, 118 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave Spanish Latin American + Quechua + te reo Maori, classic cumbia güiro and cowbell pattern, accordion melody phrases, gaita flute accents, four-on-the-floor tech-house kick, deep dub sub bass, dub delay throws on chops, congas and timbales, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, tropical-night-dancefloor mood, sidechain ducking pads to kick, club world-fusion 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(güiro shake, accordion swell, gaita flute, distant cowbell)
(SONG... PAL... cum... bia... night...)
(no... che... no... che...)
(pó... noctli... pó... noctli...)

[Build]
(cowbell pattern locks in, sub bass slides up)
SONG — PAL! CUM — BIA!
NO — CHE! NO — CHE!
TU — TA! PŌ — NOCT — LI!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(timbale roll, accordion climb)

[Drop 1]
(four-on-the-floor tech-house kick, full cumbia groove)
CUM — BIA!
NO — CHE!
BAI — LA!
LIGHT — IT!
(chop stack +7) si-si-arr-arr / āe-āe-si-si
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(accordion solo phrase, gaita accents, chops trade)
(¿dónde?) (maypi?) (kei hea?)
(¡aquí!) (kaypi!) (konei!)
(¡baila!) (tusuy!) (kanikani!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE NIGHT —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to accordion + güiro alone, dub delay throws)
(whispered) songpal... cumbia... night...
(soft) noche... noche...
(soft) pŌnoctli... tuta...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(timbale roll builds, kick returns)

[Drop 2]
(double-time tech-house, full cumbia stack peak, dub delays)
SONG — PAL — CUM — BIA — NIGHT! (si si si!)
BAI — LA! (tusuy! kanikani!)
NO — CHE! (āe āe āe!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(kick fades, accordion resolves, dub delay echoes)
(songpal... cumbia... night...)
(noche... tuta...)
(pŌnoctli... pŌ...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(güiro shake holds, fade to silence)
